programme.title: Budhwaar
programme.desc: In this captivating story, a man residing in a village embarks on a journey to purchase a piece of land within his community, seeking assistance from the sarpanch. Despite his wife and the sarpanch's warnings against buying the land on Budhwaar (Wednesday) due to its inauspicious nature, the man disregards their concerns and proceeds with the purchase. Filled with joy, he begins digging the land with aspirations of cultivating vegetables. However, his enthusiasm is short-lived as he soon discovers the land's infertility. His dreams are shattered as the realization dawns upon him that he has fallen victim to a deceitful scheme. What he decides to do next is a must-see, making this story all the more intriguing.

programme.title: Bandage
programme.desc: A young-adult, aspiring boxer, Aditya, trains with his father to become the best. However, he starts questioning his ambition and skills to make it to the top. Battling with his own troubles, the father tries to motivate Aditya. Will the father-son duo emerge victoriously, or will they crumble down in the face of their adversities?

programme.title: Cratch
programme.desc: When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes COLLIDE there would be Chaos, Confusion & a lot of disagreement, but would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Watch this short to find out Kamrul's unique take on Life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.

programme.title: Bhool
programme.desc: A young actor in dire straits assumes the identity of a retired Army Officer's son in real life to leverage his housing arrangement. The officer, battling memory loss, eventually uncovers the harsh reality about his long-lost son, prompting the actor to flee for his life.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: An anxious boy is confused if marijuana helps him with his issues. His quest to answer this dilemma leads him into a night full of corruption and deceit.

programme.title: Charitra Varnan
programme.desc: A cab driver comes across a woman standing and crying along the roadside. He tries to help her and tells her that he would drop her home safely. What happens next will leave you stunned.

programme.title: Divorce Celebration
programme.desc: While staging a sarcastic pre-divorce photoshoot, a couple is forced to confront the memories and emotions that prove their love isn’t as over as they thought.

programme.title: Prem Patra
programme.desc: In 1970s India, Sakshi, a curious college girl, stumbles upon a hidden envelope under a garden bench while searching for a dropped coin. Inside is a nameless, heartfelt love letter. Drawn in by its mystery, Sakshi returns the next day—only to find a new letter, this time from the lover’s other half. What begins as a fleeting curiosity becomes a quiet obsession, as Sakshi discovers an untold romance between two people separated by caste and family expectations. When their letter exchange abruptly ends, Sakshi, desperate to see love triumph, writes a reply pretending to be the man. But the woman senses the lie—his scent is missing—and in heartbreak, tears the letter away. Left in disappointment, Sakshi returns once more—only to find a young man with a plastered leg searching under the same bench. Is he the one from the letters? Or just another coincidence?

programme.title: Goals
programme.desc: As Meera, our pretty in pink protagonist comes back to Bombay after spending several months apart from her beau Ranbir, the circumstances force them to evaluate the basis of their relationship. This film is a deep dive into a young adult's core problems of emotional dishonesty and preference of style over substance.

programme.title: Dubki
programme.desc: Dubki is a story based on a true incident of a female constable in male-dominated law enforcement. Despite being a tough and dominant constable at the Lalkurti police station, Ganga Yadav was troubled several times by SHO Durgesh Mishra. Ganga complained about it to the IPS officer and asked for a transfer; however, he refused to help her. The female constable was left with no other choice but to take justice into her own hands.

programme.title: Firni
programme.desc: The next-door neighbors are having a fight and they send their rude 14-year-old daughter Firni to keep her busy.

programme.title: Dwand
programme.desc: Ruby, a lower-middle-class girl was made to believe that she is beautiful, intelligent, and different and that she deserves a worthy husband. She completed her studies and wanted to be a career girl. However, the marriage happened contrary to her expectations with a traditional man Vivek of the similar lower middle-class strata. After giving birth to a girl child she revolted and joined an advertising company to shape up her career. Here begins the nightmare.

programme.title: Duty
programme.desc: Different classes in society are intertwined, with each person's actions impacting others. When individuals from various classes fulfil their responsibilities, stability is achieved. This story explores fairness and the expression of duty among people from different social strata.

programme.title: Haseen Rahasya
programme.desc: Raj, an AI engineer, has built an AI house operator Jyoti. Raj goes on a date with Sara. Sara, a chemistry teacher already having the experience of real- world experience, is icing on the cake. Everything goes smoothly. But the fun turns into fear when Jyoti says "Run to save yourself". Sara's talk with Jyoti turns the fairytale into a nightmare. What will Sara do to save her life?

programme.title: Loha Chor
programme.desc: A modest family from Haryana relocated to Dhanbad, Bihar, and took up residence in a government quarter that had previously been inhabited by the notorious "Loha Chor" gang during the 1980s in Bihar. The family encountered numerous challenges and social difficulties from both the local neighbourhood inhabitants and the remnants of the Loha Chor gang. Subsequently, law enforcement authorities conducted a raid on the premises. Through determination and courage, both the family and the protagonist of this story effectively navigated the situation in order to resolve the issue and find a resolution.

programme.title: Inphlembul
programme.desc: When two shady transport guys bicker over how dangerous their delivery consignment could be, they end up challenging each other’s a logic, knowledge, and sense of culture and language.

programme.title: Hmm
programme.desc: It all begins at a midnight bus stop, where a girl finds herself unsettled due to a stranger boy's attempts to comfort his girlfriend over a phone call. When his efforts prove unsuccessful, he starts conversing with the girl instead. Despite her apparent reluctance to engage, the boy persists in his conversation, much like a bee unwilling to leave a flower. As the night unfolds, these two unfamiliar individuals end up walking home together. Along the way, they delve into profound discussions about love and relationships. The culmination arrives in a meticulously orchestrated surprise, adding a climactic twist to their journey.

programme.title: The Exit Interview
programme.desc: The Exit Interview is a tense psychological drama set within the confined walls of a corporate HR cabin. The film follows Tanish, an employee desperate to break free from workplace abuse, only to be cornered by a relentless HR representative who refuses to let him go. Through sharp dialogue and escalating tension, the short explores themes of gaslighting, coercion, and the invisible scars of toxic corporate culture.

programme.title: The Scooter
programme.desc: The story, all names, characters, and incidents portrayed in this production are fictitious. No identification with actual persons (living or deceased), places, buildings, and products are intended or should be inferred. This is a work of fiction. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental. No person or entity associated with this film received payment or anything of value, or entered into any agreement, in connection with the depiction of any products.

programme.title: Killer By Chance
programme.desc: The story follows an introverted person who works in an office and has a small circle of friends. He becomes enamored with his female boss, and upon returning home, receives a message from a massage company offering to send a beautiful girl to his place. Initially refusing the offer, he eventually accepts and prepares for her arrival. After a night of partying and sleeping over, a tragic event occurs, revealing the true nature of the introverted man.

programme.title: Leaf
programme.desc: Raj and Neha, a newly married couple, move into a new house and soon begin sensing an eerie presence. Over time, they discover that the house is connected to their past lives, where they were caught in a karmic cycle of falling in love.

programme.title: Meera
programme.desc: In this heartfelt story, a mother calls out to her daughter, only to be scolded by her husband. Her daughter, Meera, is a special child who cannot speak or hear, yet her mother sends her to school with hope. Despite the chaos and negativity around her, Meera remains blissfully unaware, finding beauty and positivity in everything. Her innocence and zest for life serve as a touching reminder of the purity within, even in a world filled with harsh words.

programme.title: Mentoo
programme.desc: A director is accused by an upcoming actress of harassing her and asking her to sleep with him and he would cast her in his next film, these allegations literally destroy his career, but are all allegations always true?

programme.title: Kundli
programme.desc: Kundli - is a film about values in life, which change some decisions against the will of the characters. It's about two meetings of these characters in a different time period and shows the changes that have occurred in their lives. Though along with time things have changed but there are something’s which are unforgettable at the back of the mind. Kundli is a film about small things that have remained though the times have changed.

programme.title: Love Ishtory
programme.desc: Chhavi belongs to a Brahmin family. She loves Aakash who is from a backward caste. Chhavi’s father is very disappointed with her daughter’s decision. Her father orders local inspector Dubey to catch Aakash to rough him up. But Chhavi’s elder brother Vicky appears in between. Vicky’s intention seems as he will blow Aakash’s head off. But there is a twist in the tale.

programme.title: In Your Arms
programme.desc: Payal and Nikhil have been married for 14 years, have lived happily and celebrated all the important occasions together. But now, sitting at the breakfast table, Nikhil breaks his silence, tells Payal that he does not want to drag this relation any further since there is no love left in their relationship. He confesses that he is in love with his colleague and they should get a divorce. Payal tells him that she will give him divorce but she has conditions which need to be fulfilled. Will Nikhil agree to it? What is the condition? Watch this awesome romantic short film to find out.

programme.title: Late Night Taxi
programme.desc: All the fears of a girl come to life after she travels in a late-night taxi she had booked. Does she reach home safely?

programme.title: Life 2.0
programme.desc: Life 2.0 is the reflection of modern life, where Humans have become like God. GOD means generator, operator & destroyer but look at us, what are we doing; we are also doing the same.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: Suffering from amnesia, a young man trying to discover his true identity is kidnapped by an underground crime organization and turned into a ruthless assassin

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: John awakens from a coma to discover his wife and daughter were murdered in a brutal home invasion. Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

programme.title: Barat
programme.desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Laugh
programme.desc: A film about who we were and who we've become , how socialising was and where its reached ,how something as simple as laughing has taken a complicated turn

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

programme.title: Ted Bundy: American Boogeyman
programme.desc: This is the true story behind the manhunt that brought America’s most fearsome boogeyman to justice. His name is Ted Bundy. A specter roams the highways of the gritty 1970s America hunting for his next prey. Tracking him are intrepid FBI female agent Kathleen & Robert Ressler organizers of the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America’s most Notorious infamous serial killer.

programme.title: Spytime

programme.title: The Free Fall

After attempting to take her own life, a young woman must wrestle with an overbearing husband and the only way out of this hell, is to fall into it.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: While the group of friends explore a beautiful small island, all hell breaks loose for Jessie as the rogue shark sets its hunting grounds within the vicinity. A Father with a score to settle brings his war to their doorstep.

programme.title: Room 203
programme.desc: Many residents of ROOM 203 have disappeared since the murder suicide of a married couple exactly fifty years ago. Lifelong friends Kim and Izzy and roommates are terrified by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their apartment. To save Izzy's life, Kim may need to sacrifice her own. Based on the Internationally Bestselling novel by Kamon Nanami.

programme.title: Butcher's Crossing
programme.desc: Butcher’s Crossing is an epic adventure journey of a team of buffalo hunters that follows a young Harvard drop-out into the Colorado wilderness as he joins a team lead by Miller (Academy Award© winner NICOLAS CAGE) in search of a mythic herd of buffalo in 1874. The journey puts his life and sanity at risk. The adventure will get horrific, confrontation with dark will lead to descent of madness.

programme.title: Warhorse One
programme.desc: During the 2021 US military withdraw from Afghanistan, a SEAL team helicopter is shot down by a group of terrorists. A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief miraculously surviving the crash, while the rest of his team killed in action must guide a child to safety through a hostile Taliban armed forces and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: On the event of 'Karwa Chauth', Indravadhan declares to Gayatri that she is not only the queen of Ameekot, but she also is his wife. Raj Mata is delighted to witness the change in Indravadhan. Meanwhile, Kuwar Singh and Kokila also celebrate the 'Karwa Chauth'. While Indravadhan was about to feed Gayatri something, Badi Raani Maa shows up and stops him. Indravadhan then witnesses a figure walking towards him and when the figure gets clear, he gets a shock. What did Indravadhan see and why is he shocked? Keep watching the interesting episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani'.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji is shocked as Sulakshana has returned. He is confused between his relationships between Sulakshana and Gayatri. When Sulakshana confronts Ranaji, he tells her to keep her distance and says that she is not really Sulakshana. As Ranaji leaves, Sulakshana utters the words when she sees someone coming her way. Is this woman really Sulakshana? Keep watching ' Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan is about to break Gayatri's fast, but Sulakshana shows up. She walks away and Indravadhan follows her and they engage in an argument. Sulakshana tells Indravadhan that she did not know about herself and it was Badi Raani Maa, who told her about him and herself. At the same time, Gayatri shows up in the scene to sort out the issue. How will Gayatri handle the issue? Keep watching 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Swarnlekha escapes from Laksharaj and is unable to be found. Unfortunately, no one at the Raj Mahal inquires about Swarnlekha. Lakshraj claims that he would find Swarnlekha before the members of Raj Mahal return back. On the other hand, Sulakshana asks Indravadhan about the place which they have visited. She tells Indravadhan that Badi Rani Maa had told her about this place. She says that she and Indravadhan had met each other for the first time here. On the other hand, Gayatri feels uncomfortable and walks out of the scene. How will Indravadhan console Gayatri? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji meets Gayatri and he asks her whether she loves him. Gayatri tells him to look in the eye and find out. Meanwhile, the woman who they think is Sulakshana is actually a fraud wearing Sulakshana's mask. Meanwhile, Swarnalekha runs away from Lakshyaraj and his men who are tyring to kill her. An unknown man comes to help when she pleads with him. How will this man help her out? Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Sulakshana and Indravadhan engage into a conversation where the latter tells the former about his love for her. The woman disguised as Sulakshana refuses to listen to Indravadhan's lecture. While Indravadhan is having his back faced towards Sulakshana, the secret woman shows up before Sulakshana and hits her on her head. She then cuts her wrists and allows her to bleed. When Indravadhan turns around, he is flabbergasted seeing Sulakshana's state. Later, Badi Raani Maa tells Indravadhan that Sulakshana has cut her wrist because she was emotionally hurt. Will Indravadhan learn the reality of Sulakshana? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The woman in black saree is revealed as Indravadhan's grandmother, Badi Raani Maa. Kuwar and Kokila are flabbergasted to find Badi Raani Maa plotting against Indravadhan. Badi Raani Maa then narrates the story of her life and reveals that she was her husband's second wife. She tells Kuwar Singh that she would not let Indravadhan extend his rule on the Ameerkot. It is also revealed that it was Badi Raani, who hired a woman to act as Sulakshana. What more plans is Badi Raani Maa going to plot against Gayatri? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri confronts Sulakshana and apologizes to her for interfering in her and Indravadhan's life. Sulakshana tells Gayatri that she would only forgive her if she follows her terms and conditions. Gayatri nods as she claims to follow Sulakshana's terms and conditions. Sulakshana claims that Gayatri would now be her slave and work for her. Hearing this, Indravadhan and Raj Mata are flabbergasted. Indravadhan shouts at Sulakshana and claims that Gayatri is his wife. Gayatri replies to Indravadhan saying that she is his second wife. Will Gayatri agree to be Sulakshana's slave? Keep watching the enrapturing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: On the event of 'Karwa Chauth', Indravadhan declares to Gayatri that she is not only the queen of Ameekot, but she also is his wife. Raj Mata is delighted to witness the change in Indravadhan. Meanwhile, Kuwar Singh and Kokila also celebrate the 'Karwa Chauth'. While Indravadhan was about to feed Gayatri something, Badi Raani Maa shows up and stops him. Indravadhan then witnesses a figure walking towards him and when the figure gets clear, he gets a shock. What did Indravadhan see and why is he shocked? Keep watching the interesting episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani'.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji is shocked as Sulakshana has returned. He is confused between his relationships between Sulakshana and Gayatri. When Sulakshana confronts Ranaji, he tells her to keep her distance and says that she is not really Sulakshana. As Ranaji leaves, Sulakshana utters the words when she sees someone coming her way. Is this woman really Sulakshana? Keep watching ' Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan is about to break Gayatri's fast, but Sulakshana shows up. She walks away and Indravadhan follows her and they engage in an argument. Sulakshana tells Indravadhan that she did not know about herself and it was Badi Raani Maa, who told her about him and herself. At the same time, Gayatri shows up in the scene to sort out the issue. How will Gayatri handle the issue? Keep watching 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Swarnlekha escapes from Laksharaj and is unable to be found. Unfortunately, no one at the Raj Mahal inquires about Swarnlekha. Lakshraj claims that he would find Swarnlekha before the members of Raj Mahal return back. On the other hand, Sulakshana asks Indravadhan about the place which they have visited. She tells Indravadhan that Badi Rani Maa had told her about this place. She says that she and Indravadhan had met each other for the first time here. On the other hand, Gayatri feels uncomfortable and walks out of the scene. How will Indravadhan console Gayatri? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji meets Gayatri and he asks her whether she loves him. Gayatri tells him to look in the eye and find out. Meanwhile, the woman who they think is Sulakshana is actually a fraud wearing Sulakshana's mask. Meanwhile, Swarnalekha runs away from Lakshyaraj and his men who are tyring to kill her. An unknown man comes to help when she pleads with him. How will this man help her out? Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Sulakshana and Indravadhan engage into a conversation where the latter tells the former about his love for her. The woman disguised as Sulakshana refuses to listen to Indravadhan's lecture. While Indravadhan is having his back faced towards Sulakshana, the secret woman shows up before Sulakshana and hits her on her head. She then cuts her wrists and allows her to bleed. When Indravadhan turns around, he is flabbergasted seeing Sulakshana's state. Later, Badi Raani Maa tells Indravadhan that Sulakshana has cut her wrist because she was emotionally hurt. Will Indravadhan learn the reality of Sulakshana? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The woman in black saree is revealed as Indravadhan's grandmother, Badi Raani Maa. Kuwar and Kokila are flabbergasted to find Badi Raani Maa plotting against Indravadhan. Badi Raani Maa then narrates the story of her life and reveals that she was her husband's second wife. She tells Kuwar Singh that she would not let Indravadhan extend his rule on the Ameerkot. It is also revealed that it was Badi Raani, who hired a woman to act as Sulakshana. What more plans is Badi Raani Maa going to plot against Gayatri? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri confronts Sulakshana and apologizes to her for interfering in her and Indravadhan's life. Sulakshana tells Gayatri that she would only forgive her if she follows her terms and conditions. Gayatri nods as she claims to follow Sulakshana's terms and conditions. Sulakshana claims that Gayatri would now be her slave and work for her. Hearing this, Indravadhan and Raj Mata are flabbergasted. Indravadhan shouts at Sulakshana and claims that Gayatri is his wife. Gayatri replies to Indravadhan saying that she is his second wife. Will Gayatri agree to be Sulakshana's slave? Keep watching the enrapturing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Badi Raani Maa meets Gayatri and informs her about Sulakshana's birthday. She tells her that arrangements are needed to be done in order to inaugurate the event. She tells that she needs to do the arrangements on her own. Hearing this, Gayatri claims that she would do this herself and would not put her in trouble. On the other hand, Raj Mata is all set to teach Sulakshana a lesson but her plans fail as Badi Raani Maa locks her in a room. What are Raj Mata's real intentions? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan gets furious with Sulakshana and tells her that Gayatri too is his wife. He adds on that he cannot bear this kind of insult thrown on Gayatri. Baadi Raani Maa acts as though she is supporting Indravadhan. Sulakshana Insults Gayatri and leaves Indravadhan speechless. Later, Indravadhan meets Saulakshana and instructs her to stay in her limits. Sulakshana tells Indravadhan that she is his first and wife and Gayatri has nothing to do with him. What will Indravadhan's reply be to Sulakshana? to find out keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani'.
